name: Local release
changes: Its work journal is written one record at a time under a lock (the kit's storage.mjs), so two processes of it sharing its data folder keep each other's attempts.
description: An example of recording and copying a release as a plugin's performed steps: it finds a pending release for the attempt's revision, records the release, and copies the built package into a registry folder, all inside its own data folder. It never pushes.

about.en: Looks for a release waiting at this attempt's revision, and records that it was found.
about.zh: 查找此次尝试的修订上是否有待发的版本，并记下已找到。

about.en: Records the release's version, tag name and notes in this plugin's own data folder.
about.zh: 把版本号、标签名和说明记录在此插件自己的数据文件夹里。

about.en: Copies the built package, whole or not at all, into a registry folder inside this plugin's own data folder. It sends nothing anywhere else.
about.zh: 把已构建的安装包整个复制到此插件自己数据文件夹里的登记目录，要么全部复制，要么不复制。不会发往任何别处。
